sources.JUNO_2026_second_release: JUNO Collaboration, 'Measurement of Neutrino Oscillation Parameters at JUNO and Indication of the Neutrino Mass Ordering', arXiv:2609.37895 v1 (2026-09-29), abstract: sin^2 theta12 = 0.3036 +/- 0.0064, Delta m^2_21 = (7.388 +/- 0.078) x 10^-5 eV^2, normal ordering favoured (one-sided at least 2.1 sigma, Bayes factor 10.18). Its 3-sigma range derived as best +/- 3 sigma (Gaussian); theta13 from NuFIT 6.0 (normal ordering), as B1628.
sources.JUNO_2025_first_result: JUNO Collaboration, arXiv:2511.14593 (2025-11-18), as transcribed in B1628's data.json (reported there, not graded): sin^2 theta12 = 0.3092 +/- 0.0087; theta13 from NuFIT 6.0 (normal ordering).
